newsitem.title: USA: Irwin Financial Corp to split stock. [CORRECTED 22:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Irwin Financial Corp to split stock. [CORRECTED 22:53 GMT]

text.p: Irwin Financial Corp said Tuesday it will split its common stock on a two-for-one basis.
The stock split will be distributed December 30 to shareholders of record December 6 (corrects from December 23), the financial services company said.
The number of outstanding shares will rise to 11.4 million from about 5.7 million after the split, the company said.

Irwin Financial also declared a $0.12 a share common stock dividend, unchanged from the previous quarter. The dividend will be paid December 16 to shareholders of record December 23, the company said.
Irwin Financial shares rose 7/8 to 48 on Nasdaq Tuesday.
